name: hami-2-11-announcement-video
description: HAMi v2.11.0 release announcement video (zh), built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render HAMI211ZH out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-zh.mp4 && remotion render HAMI211ZHV out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-zh-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:en: remotion render HAMI211EN out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-en.mp4 && remotion render HAMI211ENV out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-en-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:nocap: remotion render HAMI211ZH out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-zh-clean.mp4 --props='{"captions":false}' && remotion render HAMI211ZHV out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-zh-vertical-clean.mp4 --props='{"captions":false}'
scripts.render:cap:en: remotion render HAMI211EN out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-en-captioned.mp4 --props='{"captions":true}' && remotion render HAMI211ENV out/hami-v2.11.0-announcement-en-vertical-captioned.mp4 --props='{"captions":true}'
